verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: 'Listen to the LORD's message!
This is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the foolish prophets who follow their own ideas and have seen nothing!
Israel, your prophets are like jackals among ruins.
You have not gone up to the broken places in the wall to repair it for the people of Israel, so that they could stand firm in battle on the day of the LORD.
Their visions are false, and their predictions are lies. They say, "The LORD says," when the LORD has not sent them. Yet they expect him to make their words come true.
Haven't you seen false visions and spoken lying predictions when you say, "The LORD says," even though I have not spoken?
So this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have spoken lies and seen false visions, I am against you, says the Lord GOD.

My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and make lying predictions. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of the people of Israel. They will not even enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
This is because they have misled my people, saying "Peace," when there is no peace. When the people build a flimsy wall, these prophets cover it with whitewash.
So tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Pouring rain will come. I will send hailstones crashing down, and a violent wind will tear it apart.
When the wall falls, won't people ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"
So this is what the Lord GOD says: In my fury I will release a violent wind. In my anger I will send pouring rain and hailstones in fury to destroy it.

I will tear down the wall you covered with whitewash and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed. When it falls, you will be destroyed under it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
So I will spend my fury against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. And I will say to you, "The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it,
those prophets of Israel who prophesied about Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, says the Lord GOD."'
Now, son of man, turn your face against the women among your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: How terrible for the women who sew magic charms for everyone's wrists and make veils of every length for people's heads, to hunt down lives! Will you hunt down the lives of my people but keep your own lives safe?

You have dishonored me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived.

So this is what the Lord GOD says: I am against your magic charms, which you use to hunt people like birds. I will tear them from your arms, and I will set free the people you have trapped like birds.
I will tear off your veils and rescue my people from your hands. They will no longer be trapped by your power. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
With your lies you discouraged the righteous, when I did not want them to be sad. And you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and save their lives.
So you will no longer see false visions or practice fortune-telling. I will rescue my people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"
